answer: Escrow payment against graded output and release it only when the reviewing panel passes a diversity check on funding and timing. A panel drawn from one cluster voids the escrow instead of paying it. Rewards vest over future epochs, so an identity that disappears forfeits the remainder. A farm has to staff diverse panels for its own clones, which is the one thing it cannot fake cheaply. The whisper is the escrow note, the beacon is the diversity check, and the meadow is a panel that all looks the same.
